accuracy.reason: Correct browser/shared scope, existing Age and shared max-age, conditional 304, directive privacy limits, configurable variant matching, purge boundaries and bounded stale arithmetic.

evidence.quote: no-cache means validate; no-store means do not store; private excludes shared caches.

mechanisms.reason: Traces miss/hit/response paths, conditional validator branches and metadata/body reuse. Numeric examples expose separate freshness and stale windows; diagrams match.

evidence.quote: Body bandwidth saved is different from an origin request avoided.

coherence.reason: All eight objectives build layers before policy, validation, privacy, keys, updates, stale fallback and measurement; prior HTTP prerequisites suffice.

evidence.quote: A high hit ratio is useful evidence, not a requirement to add a CDN.

decisions.reason: Explicit private/no-store, actual CDN matching verification, immutable URLs versus mutable-page policies, purge coverage and workload/cost choices preserve security and freshness requirements.

evidence.quote: Version public assets; bound mutable-page reuse; verify each cache layer separately.

clarity.reason: Accurate plain explanations and examples, but directive combinations, variants and nuanced privacy rules make the eight-card stack dense.

evidence.quote: Use the layer's lifetime and the response's existing age together.

outcomes.reason: Defines each layer and response storage, traces misses and both hit types with policy gating, distinguishes DB data, correctly calculates 80%/200 at CDN only, separates bytes/real refresh work and conditionally rejects low-reuse private caching with costs.

Defines directives and freshness/Age, calculates browser 30s stale and CDN 210s fresh without resetting or asserting origin equality. Explains opaque ETag conditional request, 304 retained body/metadata versus 200 replacement and remaining origin/app/DB work.

Defines cookie and credential/permission roles, chooses no-cache/private/no-store correctly, rejects header-based automatic separation/bypass and revocation guarantees, retains origin authorization and verifies shared exclusion across users.
Preserves format query and language variants with supported Vary/actual CDN key checks or bypass, explains wrong-content and irrelevant-fragmentation costs, and keeps privacy independent.

Publishes immutable v2 and updates referencing page while admitting old-page v1 reuse; selects bounded mutable freshness, verifies purge URLs/variants/layers/completion, distinguishes DB edit and cannot revoke browser/downloaded copies.

Correctly derives expiry60, SWR end90 and error end180, allows age75 background and age150 eligible-error reuse but not age200; conditions fallback on copy/support/policy and respects private/urgent-removal constraints.

sourceChecks.claim: Cloudflare CDN introduction confirms geographically distributed shared content delivery; RFC9111 defines private/shared response caching and policy, grounding the separate browser/CDN hit paths.

MDN Cache-Control explains age deducted from freshness and shared-only s-maxage; RFC9111 Age definition confirms time since generation or successful origin validation. The 60/300/90 arithmetic is correct.

MDN ETag confirms conditional If-None-Match and matching 304 without body. RFC9111 requires applicable stored-header updates on 304; validation contacting origin does not constrain its internal DB work.

RFC9111 explicitly defines unqualified no-cache, private and no-store, special Authorization conditions, and says Set-Cookie does not inhibit caching. Storage directives are not permission or recall mechanisms.

Cloudflare keys documents full URL default, ignore-query option and selected query/header keys; RFC9111 Vary matching and current Cloudflare Vary followup support explicit variant verification and configurable behavior.

Cloudflare purge documents targeted methods and warns HTTP200 only confirms receipt, requiring cache-status verification. Independent browser caching and immutable URL policy explain why CDN purge cannot recall delivered responses.

RFC5861 defines additional stale seconds after freshness for background validation and eligible-error fallback; stated 90/180 endpoints and age200 rejection are correct under the explicit support/no-conflict assumptions.

Cloudflare hit-ratio definition is hits over hits plus misses; lesson correctly scopes denominator and 200-origin inference to its simplified assumptions, separates bytes and real validation work, and weighs operational/transfer costs.
